name: Tap Rush
tagline: 30 seconds. Tap every target. Miss nothing.
description: A pure reaction test: targets pop up in the same spots for every entrant (shared seed). Tap them before they shrink away. Score = hits minus misses, with combo bonuses for speed.
skillStatement: Every entrant in a bracket receives an identical, deterministic sequence of target positions and timings derived from the platform seed. Outcome depends solely on the player's reaction time and accuracy.
